author: Steve Hillebrand/USFWS
why: Official Ovibos moschatus identification and wild Arctic National Wildlife Refuge provenance. Confirmed 2037×1432 original meets the preferred long-side resolution; photographed in Alaska.

author: unknown
why: Caption identifies a muskox bull walking uphill; full-body subject with shaggy coat amid colourful autumn tundra near Nome, Alaska. Strong poster composition; dimensions unverified.

author: Katrina Liebich/USFWS
why: Officially identified Ovibos moschatus resting in autumn tundra at Arctic National Wildlife Refuge, Alaska. Confirmed 5184×3456 original; strong resolution, but resting rather than standing.

author: Marc Eggert
why: Photographer’s caption identifies muskox in Norway; standing animal on snowy terrain offers clean contrast. Freely licensed geographic fallback; 3000-pixel delivery requested, native dimensions unverified.

author: unknown
why: Gallery explicitly labels the animal a muskox bull within its Greenland wilderness itinerary. Prominent horns and dense coat in tundra habitat; dimensions unverified.

author: Helen E. Grose
why: Documented mature wild bull on Nunavik tundra, Canada; imposing horns and shaggy coat against autumn vegetation. Original-file URL; resolution and download could not be independently verified.

author: unknown
why: Identified Greenland muskox, shown full-body grazing on green tundra with small flowers. Good geographic match and natural colour; shedding coat and lowered head are compromises. Dimensions unverified.

author: Lasse Kyed
why: Photographer identifies this as a large wild bull near Kangerlussuaq, Greenland. Geographic match, but the available linked version is only 1024×768, below the preferred resolution.
